description: Returns what applies to a declarable 10-digit TARIC code on a date: third-country duty, preferences, suspensions and quotas, anti-dumping and other trade defence, prohibitions, restrictions and controls, the documents and certificate codes each measure asks for together with the codes that declare the goods are not affected, and the Spanish layer (import VAT, excise duties, plastic packaging tax, national border controls). Give the direction and the country of origin (import) or destination (export) to get only the measures of that operation. Without a country, measures that depend on it are grouped by type. Covers the EU customs tariff (TARIC) as applied in Spain (mainland and Balearic Islands). Not valid for the Canary Islands, Ceuta or Melilla. For guidance only, not binding.

code.description: Declarable 10-digit code (dots and spaces are accepted).

country.description: Two-letter code of the country of origin (import) or destination (export), for example CN, US, MA, GB.

date.description: Reference date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today. From the first date available in the data up to one year ahead.

direction.description: Import into Spain or export from Spain.

language.description: Language of the texts returned: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca) or English (en). Official EU texts not published in Catalan are returned in Spanish.

name: get_tariff_sheet
title: Tariff sheet for a code
